name: Nox
overview: A cinematic Jellyfin theme with a floating navigation rail, layered plum surfaces, lime accent, oversized editorial heroes and fully themed login and setup screens.
description: Nox retints Jellyfin Web from a single token layer with a cinematic streaming layout: layered plum surfaces, lime action accent, large rounded editorial heroes with scrimmed artwork, spacious poster rails, responsive cards, a floating navigation rail, and themed player, dialogs, forms, login and setup screens. The layout is original and uses Jellyfin hooks without external assets or plugins.
changelog: 0.2.0: redesigned the default visual system around an original cinematic streaming layout inspired by modern editorial media products. Adds layered plum surfaces, lime accent, larger rounded hero framing, stronger artwork scrims, glass action plaques, more spacious media rails, elevated card interactions, and mobile refinements while retaining existing Jellyfin compatibility, accessibility, alternate palettes, and no-external-assets policy. 0.1.4: modern MUI app shell support.
author: Nox contributors

accent.note: Change this one property to re-skin every accent surface. Pair it with --nox-accent-rgb, the same colour as a triplet, which tinted states use.
